fields.name: cluster_name
fields.description: cluster.name — every instance of one cluster must agree on it (upstream default demo).
fields.title: Cluster name

fields.name: default_replication_factor
fields.description: cluster.default_replication_factor — replicas per replicaset for tiers that do not set their own (upstream default 1).
fields.title: Default replication factor

fields.name: default_bucket_count
fields.description: cluster.default_bucket_count — sharding buckets per tier (upstream default 3000).
fields.title: Default bucket count

fields.name: shredding
fields.description: cluster.shredding — overwrite deleted data files instead of unlinking them. Costs write bandwidth.
fields.title: Shredding

fields.name: tiers
fields.description: cluster.tier map. Filled by the server from the picodata params (tiers[] of the database form).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Tier key under cluster.tier. One tier must be named "default".
fields.title: Tier name

fields.name: replication_factor
fields.description: cluster.tier.<name>.replication_factor — instances per replicaset in this tier.
fields.title: Replication factor

fields.name: can_vote
fields.description: cluster.tier.<name>.can_vote — whether instances of this tier take part in raft voting.
fields.title: Can vote

fields.name: bucket_count
fields.description: cluster.tier.<name>.bucket_count — sharding buckets of this tier.
fields.title: Bucket count
Tiers

fields.name: instance_name
fields.description: instance.name. Filled by the server from topology; unset lets picodata derive tier_replicaset_instance.
fields.title: Instance name

fields.name: replicaset_name
fields.description: instance.replicaset_name. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Replicaset name

fields.name: tier
fields.description: instance.tier — which tier this instance joins. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Tier

fields.name: peer
fields.description: instance.peer — "host:port" of the instances used to join the cluster. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Peers

fields.name: failure_domain
fields.description: instance.failure_domain — arbitrary key/value describing where the instance runs; picodata spreads a replicaset across distinct values. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: Failure domain

fields.name: instance_dir
fields.description: instance.instance_dir — snapshots, xlogs and the TLS material live here; point it at the data disk.
fields.title: Instance directory

fields.name: iproto_listen
fields.description: instance.iproto_listen — the binary protocol socket other instances connect to.
fields.title: iproto listen

fields.name: iproto_advertise
fields.description: instance.iproto_advertise — the address other instances should use. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: iproto advertise

fields.name: http_listen
fields.description: instance.http_listen — the HTTP endpoint (webui, metrics). Empty disables it.
fields.title: HTTP listen

fields.name: pg_listen
fields.description: instance.pg.listen — the PostgreSQL wire-protocol port stroppy connects to.
fields.title: PostgreSQL listen

fields.name: pg_advertise
fields.description: instance.pg.advertise. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.title: PostgreSQL advertise

fields.name: pg_ssl
fields.description: instance.pg.ssl — requires server.crt/server.key inside instance_dir.
fields.title: PostgreSQL SSL

fields.name: admin_socket
fields.description: instance.admin_socket — the unix socket `picodata admin` attaches to.
fields.title: Admin socket

fields.name: boot_timeout
fields.description: instance.boot_timeout — seconds an instance waits to join the cluster before giving up (upstream default 7200).
fields.title: Boot timeout

fields.name: audit
fields.description: instance.audit — "file:<path>", "pipe:<command>" or "syslog:". Empty disables the audit log.
fields.title: Audit destination

fields.name: memtx_memory
fields.description: instance.memtx.memory — the in-memory storage arena; minimum 32M. The product default is 2G (upstream 64M is far too small for a benchmark).
fields.title: memtx memory

fields.name: memtx_max_tuple_size
fields.description: instance.memtx.max_tuple_size — largest single tuple (upstream default 1M).
fields.title: memtx max tuple size

fields.name: vinyl_memory
fields.description: instance.vinyl.memory — write buffer of the on-disk engine (upstream default 128M).
fields.title: vinyl memory

fields.name: vinyl_cache
fields.description: instance.vinyl.cache — read cache of the on-disk engine (upstream default 128M).
fields.title: vinyl cache

fields.name: vinyl_read_threads
fields.description: instance.vinyl.read_threads (upstream default 1).
fields.title: vinyl read threads

fields.name: vinyl_write_threads
fields.description: instance.vinyl.write_threads (upstream default 4).
fields.title: vinyl write threads

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: instance.log.level.
fields.title: Log level

fields.name: log_format
fields.description: instance.log.format.
fields.title: Log format

fields.name: log_destination
fields.description: instance.log.destination — "file:<path>", "pipe:<command>" or "syslog:". Empty logs to stderr, which is what the agent collects.
fields.title: Log destination

fields.name: custom
fields.description: Further instance.* keys, emitted verbatim at the end of the instance section as `key: value`.
fields.title: Extra instance keys

computed.expr:
("tiers" in root) ? root.tiers.map(t,
					"    " + t.name + ":\n" +
					"      replication_factor: " + string(t.replication_factor) + "\n" +
					"      can_vote: " + (t.can_vote ? "true" : "false") + "\n" +
					"      bucket_count: " + string(t.bucket_count) 
				).join("\n") : "    default:\n      replication_factor: " + string(root.default_replication_factor) + ""

!("peer" in root) || size(root.peer) == 0 ? "" :
			 "  peer: [" + root.peer.map(p, '"' + p + '"').join(", ") + "]"

!("failure_domain" in root) || size(root.failure_domain) == 0 ? "" :
			 "  failure_domain: {" + root.failure_domain.map(k, k + ": " + string(root.failure_domain[k])).join(", ") + "}"

!("custom" in root) || size(root.custom) == 0 ? "" :
			 root.custom.map(k, "  " + k + ": " + string(root.custom[k])).join("\n")

(("instance_name" in root) ? "  name: " + root.instance_name + "
" : "") +
				 (("replicaset_name" in root) ? "  replicaset_name: " + root.replicaset_name + "
" : "") +
				 (("tier" in root) ? "  tier: " + root.tier + "
" : "") +
				 (("iproto_advertise" in root) ? "  iproto_advertise: " + root.iproto_advertise + "
" : "")

rules.expr: !("tier" in root) || !("tiers" in root) || size(root.tiers) == 0 || root.tiers.exists(t, t.name == root.tier)
rules.message: instance.tier must name one of the declared tiers
